spots.name: Matugani
spots.tip: A landmark with history. Low light brings out texture; check opening hours if it's fenced.

spots.name: Bird Blind
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.
